title: Worsening pain in both knees
source: Adapted from MTS-Dialog (TrainingSet ID 912, GENHX section), CC BY 4.0. Facts are taken only from the source note and dialogue.

profile.context: Attends the clinic alone. No further social details are given in the source record.

facts.text: Has had the knee pain for several years; it has become much worse over the last few months.
The knee pain is affecting his daily activities.
Has taken anti-inflammatory medicines for the knees.
Has had cortisone injections in the knees.
Has had Synvisc injections in the knees.
The medicines and injections gave only temporary relief.
Wants to know whether anything else, such as surgery, can be done, and is concerned about the risks of infection and blood clots.
